metric_definitions.clean_top1: selected endpoint garment equals the query garment before perturbation
metric_definitions.per_garment_precision: TP_g/(TP_g+FP_g) over unique test queries; undefined denominators reported as NA, never zero-filled
metric_definitions.endpoint_exact_match: selected immutable endpoint ID equals the registered true endpoint ID
metric_definitions.identity_contamination: count of unique test queries with identity-contamination grade greater than zero
metric_definitions.component_contamination: count of unique test queries with any protected component residual or component-contamination grade greater than zero
metric_definitions.endpoint_parity: ground-truth endpoint replacement makes CanonDressGS-Endpoint and Outfit-ID Oracle use identical coefficients/residuals and produce renderer parity
metric_definitions.silhouette_iou: binary alpha>=0.5 against target garment mask>=0.5
metric_definitions.lpips: VGG LPIPS v0.1 on garment bbox plus 5 percent, aspect-preserving resize and zero pad to 256x256
